metadata.title: Kalen Benakafil | Community NGO

footer.respond: We respond as soon as we can.
footer.description: A practical community organization helping people turn care into useful local action.

home.title: Small actions. Stronger neighborhoods.
home.intro: Kalen Benakafil is a community NGO connecting people with practical ways to serve, learn, and create positive change together.
home.thrive: Make room for more people to thrive.
home.oneText: People, ideas, and practical support moving in the same direction.
home.howText: We create welcoming ways for neighbors to contribute, learn from each other, and stay connected to what is happening locally.
home.connectText: Bring people and local ideas together so support can move where it is needed.
home.learnText: Share practical knowledge, stories, and opportunities that help communities grow stronger.
home.actText: Turn good intentions into clear next steps through events, volunteering, and community projects.
home.noEvents: New events are on the way. Check back soon or
home.noPosts: We are preparing the next community update.
home.cta: Have time, an idea, or a question? There is a place for you here.

about.title: Community work starts with paying attention.
about.intro: Kalen Benakafil is a community NGO creating practical ways for people to connect, contribute, and build a more supportive local future.
about.shared: Care becomes useful when we make it shared.
about.p1: We believe healthy communities are built through everyday participation: neighbors sharing knowledge, welcoming new voices, and showing up for the work in front of them.
about.p2: Our programs and events are designed to be accessible, practical, and rooted in the strengths already present in the community.
about.approachText: No grand promises. Just thoughtful programs, honest communication, and a commitment to making participation easier.
about.accessibleText: We make room for different abilities, schedules, experiences, and ways of contributing.
about.practicalText: We focus on clear opportunities and useful support that people can take into daily life.
about.collaborativeText: We listen first and work with community members, partners, and volunteers as equals.
about.cta: Want to help shape what comes next?

events.title: There is always a next step to join.
events.intro: From workshops to community projects, events are a simple way to meet people and move an idea forward.
events.empty: No upcoming events are listed right now.
events.ask: Ask us what is being planned.

blog.title: Stories, ideas, and updates from the work.
blog.intro: Follow what is happening, what people are learning, and where you can take part next.
blog.empty: No published stories are available yet.
blog.cta: Have a story or idea to share?

contact.title: Good work usually starts with a question.
contact.intro: Tell us what you are thinking, what you need, or where you would like to help. We will point you in the right direction.
contact.reply: A human reply, not a black box.
contact.replyText: We read every message and respond as soon as we can. If your note is about an upcoming event or volunteering, include that context and we will make the next step easier.
contact.emailText: Tell us what you would like to explore.
contact.name: Your name
contact.help: Questions, ideas, partnership notes, or volunteer interest are all welcome.
contact.success: Your message is on its way. We will get back to you soon.
contact.failure: We could not send your message.

volunteer.help: There is no single way to help.

dashboard.adminGuideIntro: A quick guide to keeping the public website up to date.
dashboard.guideUploadText: Open Media, choose a JPEG, PNG, or WebP photo, add its name and alternative text in both languages, then upload it. Use the decorative option only when the image carries no information.
dashboard.guideAltText: Describe what matters in the image in a short sentence. Alternative text helps people using screen readers and is shown if an image cannot load.
dashboard.guideCoverText: Edit a post or event and choose a photo in its cover section. Wide images work best; aim for at least 1600 × 900 pixels.
dashboard.guideSliderText: Open Home slider to add photos, write captions in English and Amharic, switch slides on or off, and move them up or down. The first active slide appears first.
dashboard.guidePageTextText: Open Page content, edit the English and Amharic fields, and save each block. Text is plain text; line breaks are kept. Reset to default restores the catalog wording.
dashboard.guideSizesText: Size hints describe the recommended pixel dimensions: 1600 × 900 for wide covers, 320 × 80 or wider for a logo, 512 × 512 for a square favicon, and 1200 × 630 for social sharing. Larger pixel dimensions keep images clear on high-density screens.
dashboard.guideHelpText: Contact the site administrator or the organization’s designated website support person if you are unsure or cannot save a change.
